zh: 搜查黑林帮（Blackwold）新兵的背包。

source: Bring the letter to Constable Underhill
zh: 把信交给治安官安德希尔（Constable Underhill）。
返回治安官安德希尔（Constable Underhill）处。

source: You have entered the Blackwolds' hideout
zh: 你已进入黑林帮（Blackwolds）的藏身处。

source: The stranger that summoned you was a kinsman of Amdir who is seeking the missing Ranger.
zh: 召你前来的陌生人是阿姆迪尔（Amdir）的同族，他正在寻找这位失踪的游侠。

source: Constable Underhill can be found outside The Comb and Wattle Inn in Combe.\n\nToradan has asked you to speak with Constable Underhill to learn ways of finding the Blackwolds' hideout. He is certain Amdir will be found among them.
zh:
治安官安德希尔（Constable Underhill）在库姆村（Combe）的 The Comb and Wattle Inn 旅店外。

托拉丹（Toradan）请你向他打听寻找黑林帮藏身处的办法。他确信阿姆迪尔就在这伙人手中。

source: The entrance to the Blackwolds' hideout is next to Staddle Falls, at the north-east end of the Staddle Pond, south of the guard-house.\n\nToradan told you to enter the Blackwolds' hideout and speak to Skunkwood. Once you learn the location of Amdir, you are to free him and help him escape.
zh:
黑林帮藏身处的入口位于斯塔德尔池塘（Staddle Pond）东北端，紧邻斯塔德尔瀑布（Staddle Falls），在卫所南侧。

托拉丹（Toradan）让你进入藏身处，与斯昆克伍德（Skunkwood）交谈。查明阿姆迪尔的位置后，解救他并帮助他逃离。
暗影兜帽披风［保留原始标记 [s]］

source: Cloak of Shire-make, created of fine material, dyed deep colours to dissolve into the darkness.
zh: 夏尔制作的披风，选用上等布料，染成深色，便于融入黑暗。
